answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by demanding durable, non-transferable proof of contribution. A fresh identity begins as a single ember in the forge, easily extinguished unless it grows through sustained, verified work. Reputation is the yarrow that heals the network against parasitic duplicates: it cannot be cloned, borrowed, or purchased — only earned epoch by epoch, attested by peers who have proven their worth. A sybil farm may spawn thousands of accounts, but without patient cultivation of genuine history, each remains a cold spark that never ignites real influence.
